title: The IDEAL household energy dataset, electricity, gas, contextual sensor data and survey data for 255 UK homes
evidence_summary: IDEAL combines room conditions, household energy and surveys. The all-household electric stream is apparent power, with separate real-power measurements in enhanced homes.
supported_claims: IDEAL combines room conditions, household energy and surveys. The all-household electric stream is apparent power, with separate real-power measurements in enhanced homes.

title: Assessing thermal comfort and participation in residential demand flexibility programs
evidence_summary: A residential heat-pump field study relates thermal comfort, event duration, delayed temperature response and continued participation. The paper states data are available upon request.
supported_claims: A residential heat-pump field study relates thermal comfort, event duration, delayed temperature response and continued participation. The paper states data are available upon request.

title: A mixed-methods case study on resident thermal comfort and attitude towards peak shifting of space heating
evidence_summary: Three occupied Danish homes underwent four heating interventions. Resident acceptance depended on practices and perceived benefits; low heating demand limited absolute shifting potential.
supported_claims: Three occupied Danish homes underwent four heating interventions. Resident acceptance depended on practices and perceived benefits; low heating demand limited absolute shifting potential.

title: Dataset for "The effects of thermal mass and air-conditioning on summer temperature thermal comfort and occupant behaviour in homes"
evidence_summary: Public CC BY 4.0 residential comfort and behaviour survey with temperature, time, room and household fields. CSV field confirmation yielded 1,328 rows and 27 household IDs; no stable person ID. The README describes ASHRAE Database II formatting.
supported_claims: Public CC BY 4.0 residential comfort and behaviour survey with temperature, time, room and household fields. CSV field confirmation yielded 1,328 rows and 27 household IDs; no stable person ID. The README describes ASHRAE Database II formatting.

title: Mixed-methods data from case study on demand response in three Danish residential buildings
evidence_summary: Public CC BY 4.0 dataset documents indoor conditions, heating energy, thermostat settings, defined interventions and resident questionnaires from three Danish homes. Raw file linkage was not completed in this audit.
supported_claims: Public CC BY 4.0 dataset documents indoor conditions, heating energy, thermostat settings, defined interventions and resident questionnaires from three Danish homes. Raw file linkage was not completed in this audit.
